description: Use this when the user wants to know whether AI crawlers and AI tools can access a specific website. It reads the site's robots.txt and reports, for 10+ AI crawlers (including GPTBot, OAI-SearchBot, ChatGPT-User, ClaudeBot, PerplexityBot and Google-Extended), whether each is allowed or blocked and which rule decides it. It also reports whether the homepage loads for an automated visitor or shows a bot check (such as Cloudflare, SiteGround or AWS WAF), whether the site publishes /llms.txt, and which schema.org types the homepage declares. Input: one public website address. It fetches only robots.txt, the homepage and /llms.txt, identifying itself as PreferlyBot, and changes nothing on the site. A result for the same domain may come from a check run in the last 10 minutes. It does not report what AI tools say about the business, search rankings, or pages other than the homepage.

website.description: The public website to check, like example.com or https://www.example.com. One site per call.

name: check_ai_crawler_access

allowed.description: null when robots.txt couldn't be read

rule.description: The robots.txt rule that decides it, e.g. "Disallow: /"

structuredData.description: schema.org types declared on the homepage

title: Check AI crawler access
